messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU pool 'gpu-general-1' at autoscale ceiling, queue growth detected. AlertID: alert-gt-9999
SRE Oncall: on it. swarming now. severity? any customer-facing errors?
Alex M: queue length ~1.2k requests for generation route. throughput dropped ~60%. many pods Pending with reason 'scale-ceiling' / kube events show nodeGroup at max size.
Maria R: confirmed cluster autoscaler hit maxNodes=18 (policy enforced). cloud quota for gpu nodes is 18 for that node pool.
Kai T: I can see many pods Pending:
```
$ kubectl get pods -o wide | egrep "gen-.*Pending" | wc -l
1023
$ kubectl describe pod gen-abc-123
Events:
  Normal  FailedScheduling  10s  default-scheduler  0/18 nodes are available: Insufficient gpu, node(s) had taint {gpu=required:NoSchedule}, max nodes reached.
```
Jordan P: So autoscaler won't add new nodes because of the hard cap. we've got bursty RL workload and a few big batch jobs pinned to GPUs.
Support Lead: Customer impact: multiple production customers on RTP plan reporting 503s and increased tail latency. Ticket INC-5482 opened.
SRE Oncall: plan: 1) short-term manual node cap bump (temporary) 2) evict non-critical batch pods 3) fallback routing for high-req customers to smaller model. need approval for manual raise (cost).
Alex M: I already opened cloud request for quota bump but it's pending (case #CC-2211). That takes hours. Manual bump requires platform team to unlock policy in the control plane. @Maria R can you lift the maxNodes guard for emergency?
Maria R: I can do a temporary override but need SRE lead signoff + finance ok for immediate overspend. how many nodes do we need?
Kai T: estimates: current pending demand ~10 extra GPUs to drain queue within 20-30m. If we go from 18->28 nodes that should clear backlog. I'd prefer +6 to be conservative: 24 nodes.
Jordan P: Also we should free up GPUs by scaling down non-prod and big-batch namespaces. I'll run `kubectl -n batch scale deploy heavy-worker --replicas=0` for two jobs.
Support Lead: I'll notify affected customers that we're mitigating and provide ETA ~30-45m.
SRE Oncall: @Maria R proceed with temporary override to 24 nodes. I'll run the pod eviction and routing changes.
Maria R: doing override now. steps: unlocking policy flag `autoscale.max_nodes.override=true` for cluster 'prod-eu-1', issuing a manual resize.
deploy-bot: Deploy queue: 1 running, 0 blocked. Canary routes unaffected.
Maria R: running command:
```
# manual resize
gcloud container clusters update prod-eu-1 --node-pools=gpu-pool --num-nodes=24 --zone=europe-west1-b
```
Maria R: resize submitted. API returned operation op-5521.
SRE Oncall: monitoring node join events.
Alex M: new nodes starting to join, kubelet registering. pods scheduling. queue length falling: 1.2k -> 700 -> 300 within 10m.
Kai T: evicted 3 batch deployments, freed 6 GPUs. running `kubectl get nodes` shows 6 new gpu nodes Ready.
Support Lead: customers X and Y notified with status update. no data loss reported.
Jordan P: also turned on traffic-splitting to route 20% of RTP to smaller model variant. should reduce long running token spends.
SRE Oncall: latency moving towards normal. token TPS recovering. monitoring for any resurgence.
Maria R: note: override is temporary. I'll lock policy back after we confirm stable. also created cloud quota escalation ticket to make this permanent.
Support Lead: INC-5482 updated and customers ack'ed.
Alex M: final queue ~45, pod Pending=0.
SRE Oncall: manual cap bump to 24 succeeded. marking mitigation as complete for now. putting a page on on-call schedule for follow-up postmortem.
Jordan P: follow-ups: - postmortem to capture why autoscaler ceiling wasn't preemptively increased - ensure low-priority batch has eviction policies - better alerting for 'max_nodes reached' separate from node pressure.
Maria R: locking override now. running:
```
# re-lock
# set autoscale.max_nodes.override=false
```
Maria R: override locked. cluster policy back to maxNodes=18.
SRE Oncall: will open a dedicated follow-up ticket with timeline and action items (PM/Infra/Finance). thank you all. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: Incident annotated: mitigation=manual-node-bump; duration=~34m; impacted_customers=[Customer X, Customer Y]; follow_up=postmortem required.
Support Lead: closing thread for the live response. preserving logs and convo for postmortem.
